digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities framework (Bedrock native structured output)
propositions: E1 measurement proved native structured output + extended thinking work on specific Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 adaptive, haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 budget 2048) in account 896586841071 / us-east-1, but family-level _REBAR_OVERRIDES blanket-disables native_structured_output for all Claude.

native_output_with_thinking field is silently dropped on all three ModelCapabilities construction paths (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback, _intersect_capabilities) because none of them plumb the field from capability overrides, causing measured cells to route through PromptedOutput instead of NativeOutput.

Bedrock opus-4-7/4-8 are rejected server-side by Converse structured output under thinking (provider rollout gap) and must remain fail-closed; they carry temperature override rows but must not gain native-output rows until re-measured.

FallbackModel chains must conservatively intersect native_output_with_thinking across all candidates using all(...) logic, collapsing to False if any candidate lacks measured support, preventing chains from claiming native-under-thinking capability prematurely.

Per-cell measured facts must be scoped to exact account/region combinations with re-measure triggers recorded, because Bedrock capability facts are account/region-scoped and have been falsified on re-measurement in different accounts.
